The '''Tatooine Bureau of Travel and Commerce''' was a a bureau on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They promoted the [[Lucky Despot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
